stages.description: Discover detector structure from module positions using KMeans (radial rings) and MeanShift (z-layers). Compute layer radii, z-positions, ring gap boundaries, and monotonic z-coverage for O(1) reachability queries.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Discover layer dimensions within the source detector topology using radial Lloyd clustering and axial mean shift; retain ordering, coverage and gap rules.
stages.limits: Fixed volume groups, seven radial rings and exactly three gaps; not arbitrary detector discovery. Clustering remains independently reusable.

stages.description: Project hits to mean cylinder radius, scale x,y by zscale to create elliptical neighborhoods matching the detector's natural metric. Separate transforms for cylinder and cap layers.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Project onto mean-radius cylinders with configured transverse scaling, or onto the layer plane, before Euclidean neighbor search.
stages.limits: Projection singularities are outside the finite-input contract. Layer grouping and source scale selection remain recipe policy.

stages.description: Build sklearn NearestNeighbors index per detector layer on the rescaled coordinates. Query for k nearest neighbors within radius, returning candidate hit indices and distances.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Fit each layer index and perform configured k-neighbor and radius queries, preserving grouping and source result ordering.
stages.limits: Sparse or exhausted layers reject explicitly; fitted index objects are in-process objects, not portable serialized models.

stages.description: Fit a circumscribed circle through three x-y hit positions. The x,y-projection of a charged particle helix in uniform B-field is a circle. Handles degenerate cases (collinear/coincident) by constructing large tangent circles.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Fit the circumcircle, retaining source large-radius tangent handling for supported collinear or coincident configurations.
stages.limits: Undefined zero tangent geometry rejects instead of certifying source nonfinite output. The large-radius fallback is an approximation.

stages.description: Given circle center, z-coordinate is linear in phase angle phi. Linear regression of z vs phi for three points with careful phase-unwrapping. Sum-of-squared-residuals serves as track quality signal.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Use source phase unwrapping and two-point or three-point axial regression with residual quality and explicit zero-pitch replacement.
stages.limits: Zero phase variance rejects; the tracking recipe supplies its 0.001 replacement policy rather than making it a universal physical constant.

stages.description: Exploit that r^2 = x^2 + y^2 is a harmonic function of helix phase, so cylinder crossings reduce to solving cos(phi)=C analytically (up to 4 candidates). Pick closest forward-moving solution. Recursive miss-and-retry for lateral misses.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Compute candidate cylinder intersections, select forward motion, apply axial bounds and optional correction, and retry later layers under source recursion rules.
stages.limits: Preserve bounded retry, recursive default pre-move behavior and explicit miss sentinels; no guarantee that a future layer is reached.

stages.description: Intersect helix with planar disk detector layers (z=constant). Simpler than cylinder case but includes recursive miss-and-retry for radial gaps between cap module rings.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Intersect axial planes and apply radial coverage, ring-gap, overlap and optional correction policy with bounded later-layer retries.
stages.limits: Detector coverage and retry rules belong to the recipe; generic plane intersection remains separately selectable.

stages.description: Real trajectories deviate from perfect helices due to energy loss, scattering, and B-field inhomogeneity. Apply learned displacement maps (per-layer RegularGridInterpolator) scaled by q/momentum for physics-informed transfer across momenta.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Apply supplied per-layer interpolated correction maps with source orientation and curvature scaling, masks, missing-value handling and geometry guards.
stages.limits: The immutable stage describes applying learned maps. Map training is not part of this execution; supplied maps and calibration validity remain caller responsibilities.

stages.description: Compute nearest point on helix to a reference point. Recognizes this is equivalent to Kepler's equation E - e*sin(E) = M. Solved via Newton's method (3 iterations).
stages.reviewed_semantics: Compute the source fixed-iteration Newton approximation to nearest helix position and distance, with three iterations in the tracking recipe.
stages.limits: No global minimum or convergence guarantee; finite qualified outputs only. Optional phase/arc outputs are outside this graph boundary.

stages.description: Cut-off derived from Bayesian signal-vs-background likelihood ratio. Dense regions get tighter cuts, sparse regions get looser cuts. Adaptive thresholding based on local hit density.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Combine tangent residuals, supplied uncertainty information and local background-density policy to classify neighboring candidates.
stages.limits: Source thresholds and uncertainty coefficients remain explicit recipe policy; missing-map behavior is preserved, not statistical calibration certification.

stages.description: Process tracks in descending quality order. Discard tracks exceeding max_nloss of already-claimed hits. reserve_skipped prevents cascade pollution.
stages.reviewed_semantics: Rank candidates by descending recipe quality, then greedily claim available observations under configured minimum-count and loss bounds across commit rounds.
stages.limits: The reusable commit primitive consumes caller ordering and supports reserve-skipped policy; the source lifecycle supplies reserve_skipped=False. No global assignment optimum is claimed.

cell_reconstruction.decision: Retain the complete optional cell reconstruction as source-specific recipe logic. Keep the extracted absolute-inner-product vector selector independently reusable.
cell_reconstruction.reason: Weighted moments feed a chosen-axis regression, pixel-extent heuristic, module thickness and rotations. This is not PCA or a general covariance estimator; replacing it with either would change the source algorithm.
cell_reconstruction.limits: Synthetic positive weights, complete cell information and orthonormal module rotations; no empirical detector calibration claim.

reuse_decision: Twenty-five numerical callable dependencies remain individually selectable across domains under their own contracts. Detector topology, lifecycle, ranking, retry, correction-map dispatch and empirical cell policy remain in the tracking recipe. Whole-recipe portability requires those assumptions; no claim that every arithmetic expression is a separate atom.
compatibility_limits: Explicit empty/no-seed termination replaces source failures; sparse/exhausted layer configurations reject.
Execution produces in-memory assignments; historical scoring, truth analysis and submission-file side effects are outside the execution contract.
Synthetic source parity establishes the tested behavior, not historical accuracy, production scale or generalization.
This automated semantic review supports Tier 3 consideration only; no human Tier 1 designation.
Corrected original graph staging, stored execution, publication transactions and served retrieval remain required.
